calendar_window_note: Calendar years. Capacity endpoints are year-end; annual flow comparators Jan 1-Dec 31. Use single-vintage 2025 appendix for all physical rows.
capacity_basis: Owned-net. Renewable strict comparison excludes nuclear/battery and removes disclosed 75 MW non-incremental thermal solar from 2022/2023; original numbers retained separately.
output_basis: Own net generation. Strict RE derived by summing hydro+landfill gas+solar+wind; excludes nuclear/storage/purchases. Published renewable aggregate discrepancy retained.
emissions_basis: Power plants equity ownership share; excludes purchased power; not interchangeable with total corporate Scope1
finance_date_precision: exact dates from official debt schedule labels; 2024 workbook says December 2024 and official index labels December 31 2024
financing_window_match: yes; observed identified outstanding green bond liability inside exact physical endpoints; intermediate Q2 stocks separately verified when available
allocation_grain_stock_or_flow: No allocation observation in matched window. Historical 2021 CFO allocation certification must not be carried forward.
project_membership_supported: Historical 2021 list only; replacement of three original projects explicitly disclosed; no in-window unchanged pool evidence
implementation_stage_supported: Physical operating fleet in matched window; financed-project status only historically available for 2019 projects; do not attribute all company additions to bond
strict_RE_storage_exclusion_gate: pass: zero hydro and separate battery stock; nuclear never counted as renewable
missing_or_exclusion_reasons: No repeated in-window allocation/implementation-stage project panel. 2022 reported RE output differs from component sum by 18000 MWh, 2023 by -1 MWh. 75 MW non-incremental thermal solar treatment harmonized explicitly. FPL Daniel 502 MW is dispatch/ownership-share exit, not whole-plant closure. Do not infer causal green-finance effect.
